body.purpose: Task titles, form fields, buttons, empty-state copy.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action button on a screen: sign in, add task, save.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">+ เพิ่มงาน</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: Prompt, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #2d2a3a); background: var(--surface, #fffdf8); color: var(--ink, #2d2a3a); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 13px; cursor: pointer; transform: translateY(0); transition: transform .08s ease; } .ds-btn::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -2px; right: -2px; bottom: -5px; height: 5px; background: var(--ink, #2d2a3a); z-index: -1; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(3px); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary, #ffc23c); border-color: var(--ink, #2d2a3a); } .ds-btn-primary::after { background: var(--primary-edge, #dd9a1e); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions: cancel, sign out, pagination.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: Prompt, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #2d2a3a); background: var(--surface, #fffdf8); color: var(--ink, #2d2a3a); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 13px; cursor: pointer; transform: translateY(0); transition: transform .08s ease; } .ds-btn::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -2px; right: -2px; bottom: -5px; height: 5px; background: var(--ink, #2d2a3a); z-index: -1; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-alt, #fff1d6); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(3px); }

components.name: Danger Outline Button
components.description: Delete actions only, in a two-click confirm sequence (label changes to "ยืนยัน?" on first click).
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: Prompt, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #2d2a3a); background: var(--surface, #fffdf8); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 13px; cursor: pointer; transform: translateY(0); transition: transform .08s ease; } .ds-btn::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -2px; right: -2px; bottom: -5px; height: 5px; z-index: -1; } .ds-btn-danger { color: var(--danger, #ef476f); border-color: var(--danger, #ef476f); } .ds-btn-danger::after { background: var(--danger-edge, #c62f52); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--surface-alt, #fff1d6); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: translateY(3px); }

components.name: Work Chip
components.description: Marks a task or event as "งาน" (Work). Appears in list rows, kanban cards, and calendar chips.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: Prompt, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 4px; color: #fff; } .ds-chip-work { background: var(--work, #3a86ff); }

components.name: Personal Chip
components.description: Marks a task or event as "ส่วนตัว" (Personal).
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: Prompt, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 4px; color: #fff; } .ds-chip-personal { background: var(--personal, #ef5da8); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Task title, notes, and every other free-text field in the add-task form.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="ชื่องาน">
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: Prompt, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 2px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #2d2a3a); background: var(--bg, #fdf5e6); color: var(--text, #2d2a3a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary, #ffc23c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: One of three view toggles (List / Kanban / Calendar) living inside a bordered pill container; pairs a line icon with Thai text.

narrative.overview:
Life Dashboard is a single-user daily tool, not a marketing surface, so it commits to the opposite of a corporate SaaS dashboard: a warm cream page covered in chunky, hand-outlined stickers rather than a slick glass panel with ambient shadows. Every panel, button, and card is drawn with a solid 2px ink border and a flat fill, no blur, no soft elevation, nothing ambient. The one place depth appears is a button press: each button sits on a solid-color pedestal it physically pushes into on click, like pressing a real sticker down onto paper.

The palette is small and each color carries exactly one meaning: sky blue for work, bubblegum pink for personal, mint only for done, amber for the one action on screen, cherry only for delete. Icons are a small hand-drawn line set that replaced an earlier pass built on emoji.
keyCharacteristics: Flat and shadowless — depth comes from borders and pedestals, never box-shadow.
2px solid ink borders and 0 border-radius everywhere except the 4px chip.
Chunky buttons that visibly press down 3px on click (transform-only).
A two-tone candy palette where every accent color has exactly one job.
A small authored 24x24 line-icon set; no emoji anywhere in the interface.

rules.name: The One Job Per Color Rule
rules.body: Every accent maps to exactly one meaning app-wide. If a color appears, it is communicating that specific thing, never decoration.

rules.name: The Four-Size Rule
rules.body: Exactly four font sizes exist app-wide (11 / 14 / 18 / 22px). A new component reaches for one of these; it does not introduce a fifth.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow does not appear anywhere in this system. Depth is drawn with borders and solid-color pedestals only.

dos: Do keep every border 2px solid Cocoa Ink (or the matching accent) at 0 radius.
Do reserve Minty Fresh for completion states only.
Do animate button presses with transform against a static pedestal.
Do draw new icons in the same 24x24, 2px-stroke, round-cap line style.
Do stay inside the four-size type scale.
donts: Don't use an emoji or other Unicode glyph as a stand-in icon.
Don't round a corner beyond the 4px chip exception.
Don't let amber, blue, pink, mint, or cherry mean anything other than their one assigned role.
